topic: Deploying updated analytics script to staging environment
summary_markdown:
The discussion centered on a technical issue where an analytics query (specifically for frequency logs) failed, returning a 503 Service Temporarily Unavailable error when attempting to pull metrics for Helsinki for the last week. Initial suggestions included reverting to an older version of the script, but it was determined that the development environment might be experiencing resource constraints rather than the staging environment.

Ultimately, [me] requested that a specific build (`20260205.080500-fix_multithread-e44d0b6`) be deployed to the staging environment.
decisions: The script version `20260205.080500-fix_multithread-e44d0b6` will be deployed to the staging environment.
action_items: [p3] needs to deploy build `20260205.080500-fix_multithread-e44d0b6` to stage.
